mapper.select: SELECT c.status AS stage, COUNT(*) AS count FROM rec_candidate c WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.status
SELECT c.source AS source, COUNT(*) AS count FROM rec_candidate c WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.source

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM rec_candidate c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM rec_candidate c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} - 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
